rating.description: Legacy: ratings now live in the linked Popfeed review (popfeedReview). Read only from records without one.

source.description: Where the record came from, e.g. import:trakt.

comment.description: Legacy: review texts now live in the linked Popfeed review (popfeedReview). Read only from records without one.

reaction.description: Moods of this viewing: shocked, touched, amused, scared, bored, thrilled, confused, tense (Bingers' feelings; zelk only: Popfeed has none).

precision.description: How precise watchedAt is. Imported history is often only minute-accurate.

popfeedItem.description: The social.popfeed.feed.listItem marking the movie as watched (on the watched_movies list).

popfeedReview.description: The social.popfeed.feed.review holding the rating and review text of this viewing. Replies and reactions go to it, so zelk.tv and Popfeed share one thread.

favoriteCharacter.description: Identifier of the viewer's favorite character (opaque, source-specific).

main.description: A single viewing (the dated diary entry) of a movie. The record key is deterministic: <idprefix><id>-<watchedAt as YYYYMMDDHHmm UTC>, e.g. tmdb99861-202302042259. What Popfeed already models lives in Popfeed records, linked here: the title marked as watched (social.popfeed.feed.listItem) and the rating and review text (social.popfeed.feed.review). This record keeps what Popfeed has no place for: the date of each viewing, its moods and its favorite character.

subject.description: At least one identifier should be present.
